name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B for EXCAVA. It’s the cheapest 128K-context model with proven performance on complex reasoning tasks, giving us a measurable boost in output quality without burning GPU hours. The trade-off is accepting its slightly slower inference speed compared to smaller models, but the net gain in capability per dollar outweighs the latency hit.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K claim is vendor marketing—our tests show it collapses past 32K, so adopting it risks degrading EXCAVA’s reliability. Instead, test Mistral Large 2.1’s 128K claim under load; if it fails, default to a 32K model with proven stability like Llama3.1-8B. Settle this with a controlled benchmark: run identical tasks at 32K and 128K, measure output quality drop, and pick the model that loses less than 0.5% capability.
